connector.name: Coinvoyage
connector.registryDescription: CoinVoyage MCP - create crypto PayOrders, webhooks, swaps across Bitcoin/Solana/EVM chains.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package coinvoyage-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kingpeque account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: COINVOYAGE_API_KEY
env.description: Your CoinVoyage public API key. Get one at https://dashboard.coinvoyage.io (Developers section).

env.name: COINVOYAGE_API_SECRET
env.description: Server-side API secret. Required for SALE/REFUND PayOrders, fee claims, and webhook management. Leave unset if you only need DEPOSIT (merchant invoice) flows.

env.name: COINVOYAGE_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.coinvoyage.io.
